authorityOrder.rule: Observed reality may revise or reject any model, reading, reconstruction or projection.
Admitted evidence constrains claims and reconstructions but does not equal total reality.
Reconstruction is model-mediated and must expose evidence gaps, conflict and uncertainty.
Projection is conditional possibility under explicit assumptions and constraints.

sourceAuthorityRule: Source authority governs evidence admission, not reality itself.
providerRule: Moomoo and other MARKET_DATA_PROVIDER sources may provide high-density market observations. They do not outrank official/regulatory/issuer authority for formal claims and never generate a PHI OS verdict directly.
aiRule: AI may assist classification, compression, comparison and anomaly discovery; it cannot create evidence authority or override reality.
humanRule: Human review is required at governed semantic/threshold/admission boundaries defined by the relevant runtime contract.
